import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={"default": {"ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3", "NAME": ":memory:"}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=["django.contrib.contenttypes", "django.contrib.auth"],
    DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD="django.db.models.AutoField",
)
django.setup()

from django.db import models, connection


class Base(models.Model):
    base_id = models.AutoField(primary_key=True)
    field_base = models.IntegerField()

    class Meta:
        app_label = "repro"


class OtherBase(models.Model):
    otherbase_id = models.AutoField(primary_key=True)
    field_otherbase = models.IntegerField()

    class Meta:
        app_label = "repro"


class Child(Base, OtherBase):
    class Meta:
        app_label = "repro"


with connection.schema_editor() as se:
    se.create_model(Base)
    se.create_model(OtherBase)
    se.create_model(Child)

OtherBase.objects.create(field_otherbase=100)
OtherBase.objects.create(field_otherbase=101)
Child.objects.create(field_base=0, field_otherbase=0)
Child.objects.create(field_base=1, field_otherbase=1)

rows = Child.objects.update(field_otherbase=55)
print("update() returned:", rows)
print("Child values:", list(Child.objects.values("field_otherbase")))
print("OtherBase 1,2:", list(OtherBase.objects.filter(otherbase_id__in=[1, 2]).values("field_otherbase")))

child_vals = [r["field_otherbase"] for r in Child.objects.values("field_otherbase")]
other_vals = [r["field_otherbase"] for r in OtherBase.objects.filter(otherbase_id__in=[1, 2]).values("field_otherbase")]
assert child_vals == [55, 55], f"FAIL: Child not updated: {child_vals}"
assert other_vals == [100, 101], f"FAIL: unrelated OtherBase rows clobbered: {other_vals}"
assert rows == 2, f"FAIL: update count {rows}"
print("PASS: Child updated to 55; unrelated OtherBase rows untouched.")
